bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; modifying the construction project exception to the school year calendar start date; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120A.40.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120A.40, is amended to read:

120A.40 SCHOOL CALENDAR.

Subdivision 1.

Beginning the school year.

Except for learning programs during summer, flexible learning year programs authorized under sections 124D.12 to 124D.127, and learning year programs under section 124D.128, a district must not commence an elementary or secondary school year before Labor Day, except as provided under subdivision 2. Days devoted to teachers' workshops may be held before Labor Day. Districts that enter into cooperative agreements are encouraged to adopt similar school calendars.

Subd. 2.

Exceptions.

A district may begin the school year on any day before Labor Day:
(1) to accommodate a construction or remodeling project of $500,000 or more affecting a district school facility and in accordance with the requirements of subdivision 3;
(2) if the district has an agreement under section 123A.30, 123A.32, or 123A.35 with a district that qualifies under clause (1); or
(3) if the district agrees to the same schedule with a school district in an adjoining state.

Subd. 3.

Construction or remodeling projects.

(a) A construction or remodeling project that qualifies for an exception to begin the school year before Labor Day under subdivision 2, clause (1), must also meet the following requirements:

(1) the cost threshold of $500,000 or more must apply to a single school facility;

(2) the construction or remodeling project must take place on the school site; and

(3) the construction or remodeling project must not be completed while students are present.

(b) A new construction project at a separate school site does not qualify for an exception under subdivision 2.
